title: Synthetic National Topographic Map Demonstration Specification
notice: This is a synthetic benchmark fixture. It is not an official Taiwan specification.

rules.message: The public GeoJSON exchange fixture must declare OGC:CRS84.

evidence.excerpt: The public GeoJSON exchange profile uses OGC:CRS84.

rules.message: River centreline features must use LineString geometry.

evidence.excerpt: The geometry class of J01_RIVERL is LineString.

rules.message: Every feature must have a non-empty authoritative feature identifier.

evidence.excerpt: feature_id is mandatory and shall not be synthesized during validation.

rules.message: Every demonstration river feature must have a non-empty name.

evidence.excerpt: name is mandatory for the public demonstration layer.

rules.message: Version 2024 requires the source observation date.
river_class must use a value from the specification code list.

evidence.excerpt: The 2024 code list adds tidal to primary, secondary, and drainage.

rules.message: feature_id values must be unique within the layer.

evidence.excerpt: feature_id is the layer-wide unique identifier.

rules.message: A river centreline must not self-intersect.

evidence.excerpt: J01_RIVERL geometry shall be simple and free from self-intersections.

rules.message: Names should not contain leading or trailing whitespace.

evidence.excerpt: String values are stored without leading or trailing whitespace.
